hint.draw: Drag across the glass, from one corner to the opposite one.
hint.fit: Drag an edge or a corner to fit it. Scroll in until the glass starts to hide the picture, then back out a notch. V checks it from the side.
hint.side: Scroll until the picture sits on the glass, and lean it (Q / E) until it lies flat on it. F goes back to the front.
hint.edge: Too far round to drag from here: F faces the screen again.
hint.looking: Looking around. Let go to get the cursor back.

notes.snapped: On the prop's surface. Scroll in until the glass starts to hide the picture, then back out a notch
notes.no_surface: Nothing to sit it on there: use the wheel
notes.copied: Copied: paste it into Models in configs/shared/screens.lua

props.hint: Add any prop model the game has, streamed ones included. A computer can then be placed as it, one can be picked from the world, and the Automatic tab offers it to every automatic computer. Then draw its screen, from its tile in the Props tab.
props.tab_hint: Every prop a computer can be: placed as, picked from the world as, or ticked in the Automatic tab. The ones from configs/shared/admin.lua are changed in that file; the ones added here can be removed here.
props.taken: That prop is already on the list.
props.label: Name
props.screen_hint: A prop of your own has no screen until you draw one: Draw screen, under it in the Props tab. Until then it is still a computer, opening fullscreen.
props.screen_none_hint: It has no screen yet, so it opens fullscreen and shows nothing in the world. Draw where its screen is.
props.screen_adjust_hint: Redraw where the screen is on this prop
props.screen_reset: Take the drawn screen away: back to the built-in one, if it has one

warnings.floating: Floating %s m above the ground — press Alt to drop it

overview.rule_boot: Boot sequence when a computer opens
overview.rule_reach: A computer closes itself %s m away
